description: The audit-service root through main() on a labelled disposable PostgreSQL (one fresh schema, init-db first, a fixture git repository with one pinned commit): status of an unknown audit (known_audit false), run --once of an unknown audit and run --max-tasks 0 --once (both refused by the activation gate before any observer, executor or transport; the runtime directory listing shows only the lock file and the empty workspaces root, no observer spool) and status of a seeded audit (a research_audits row, two research_partitions rows, one unsubmitted schedule row and an active activation row, through the store transaction api); stdout, stderr and exit code per case, the fixture path normalized to <FIXTURE>, no mask. A run that passes the gate enters the executor and is excluded (no provider)
